Name: (CP) Dacar style portraits for Lucikiel
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
[size=2]Who could've guessed I would end doing this one huh.

Lucikiel made in my style is here! In order to not burn myself, and to test a bit a new way to do my portraits now that I can animate them, I've done this (Also cause I was asked in SDV Discord). I'm still working on RSV don't worry, that will come out later. This mod only works with Portraiture [i]for now[/i], It has all the necessary frames to work with the upcoming animated portraits mod, once that is out I'll update the code and the mod so that it works with that!

This mod has Wedding Reception protraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31890]here[/url]﻿! 

[color=#00ff00]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color]
[color=#00ff00]**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*[/color]
[color=#00ff00]Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.[/color]
[color=#00ff00]In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:[/color]

[color=#00ff00]-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP[/color]

[color=#00ff00]-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:[/color]
[color=#00ff00]"active": "HDP" [/color]
[color=#00ff00]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color][/size]
